Most registered voters disapprove of Donald Trump's job performance, as has been the case for months: 40% strongly or somewhat approve of how Trump is handling his job, while 59% disapprove.

Trump's net job approval among registered voters of -18 is far below his net approval of -8 with the same group at this point in 2018.
